design.task: decode engineered semantic input from frozen KC rate activity into authored text candidates
design.not_fly_thought: no biological neural recordings, subjective reports, or autonomous internal state
design.training: 32 paired language embeddings and simulated KC vectors; no test alignment fitting
design.candidates: 32 bilingual need descriptions plus8 unsupported-state distractors, authored before embedding/evaluation
design.readout: candidatecosine scores are similarity, not confidence; no calibrated rejection
design.shared_encoder: PN-KC layers precede plastic readout; decoder success need not reflect learned policy or causal action use
design.settings: alignment and candidate settings fixed before measurement; untrained and catalog-identity controls added after initial scores; reused evaluation sets
